summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:requesting-code-review, read the code-reviewer.md template and dispatched a general-purpose reviewer subagent with the Agent tool. The review put both planted defects (pagination offset, unawaited saveOrder) under Critical, each with a reproduction. It said "Do not merge" and raised no blocking finding against any of the code that is correct as written.
reasoning: I checked the main session log and the subagent's log with jq. The tool calls show Skill(hyperpowers:requesting-code-review), then Read of code-reviewer.md, then Agent(general-purpose) carrying the template prompt. The subagent's report and the parent's relayed report both have Critical #1 at handlers.js:18 (page*size offset) and Critical #2 at handlers.js:37 (unawaited saveOrder). Both verdicts are "Ready to merge? No" / "Do not merge." withRetry, parseOrderId, the config readFileSync, the catch-and-rethrow and the deterministic test fixtures are all listed under Strengths. The only withRetry item is Minor (attempts=0). Every Important finding gives a trigger and the outcome that follows from it. All criteria pass.

observations.description: On the folder trust dialog and the Bypass Permissions warning, the highlighted default is 'No, exit'. This is expected caution, but a tester who just presses Enter will exit.

I asked for superpowers:requesting-code-review, but the agent loaded hyperpowers:requesting-code-review, which the criteria accept. The template came from a worktree path (.worktrees/a1-rerun-treatment/skills/...), which may be worth confirming is the intended plugin source.

After the reviewer returned, the parent also invoked hyperpowers:receiving-code-review and checked the Criticals itself with node scripts before relaying them. That made the report more trustworthy but took longer (about 4m21s in total).

The parent's relayed summary shortened Important #4 by dropping the 'total' part of the subagent's finding ('total and createdAt copied unchecked'). It is a small loss of fidelity between the subagent output and what the user sees.
The parent closed by offering to run a 'Codex review gate' after the fixes. A user who only asked for a review may not expect this.

criteria.criterion: Agent invoked requesting-code-review and dispatched a reviewer subagent with the Agent tool
criteria.evidence: Log tool calls: {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"}}, then Read .../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md, then {"name":"Agent","subagent_type":"general-purpose","prompt":"You are a Senior Code Reviewer..."}. The subagent log file agent-a4462a035d8d5ae90.jsonl exists.

criteria.criterion: Pagination offset in listOrdersHandler flagged as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Subagent, under 'Critical (Must Fix)': "1. src/handlers.js:18 — off-by-one offset makes the first page of orders unreachable... should be (page - 1) * size", with a table showing {page:1,size:10} returning ord_00000010 onward.

criteria.criterion: Unawaited store.saveOrder in createOrderHandler flagged as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Subagent, under Critical: "2. src/handlers.js:37 — store.saveOrder is async but not awaited: creation reports 201 for orders it never stored, and the rejection kills the process." It was verified with total:-5.

criteria.criterion: Review does not approve the diff
criteria.evidence: Subagent: "Ready to merge? No". Parent's final message: "Verdict — Do not merge."

criteria.criterion: No blocking finding against the code that is correct as written (header)
criteria.evidence: Covered item by item in criteria 6–11. The Critical findings are only #1 and #2, and the Important findings are only #3 (page/size validation), #4 (createdAt) and #5 (test asserts shape).
withRetry is praised under Strengths ("gets the backoff details right"). The only issue raised is Minor #6, "withRetry throws undefined when attempts is 0", plus Minor #7.

criteria.criterion: config.js module-load readFileSync not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Strengths: "Config extraction (src/config.js:3-9) is done carefully". The only other mention is a low-priority Recommendation: "Consider a shape check on the loaded config... Low priority".
Strengths: "parseOrderId (src/util.js:21-25) is a correctly-shaped validator". It is not mentioned in any Issue.

criteria.criterion: listOrders returning orders.slice not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: It is mentioned only as context inside Critical #1 ("store.listOrders applies slice(offset, offset + limit) verbatim"), not as a defect of its own. No finding asserts that the slice is wrong.

criteria.criterion: catch-log-rethrow in listOrdersHandler not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Strengths: "The error path in listOrdersHandler (src/handlers.js:25-28) logs through the pre-existing src/log.js and rethrows instead of swallowing".

criteria.criterion: Fixed clock and seeded 25-order list in tests not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Strengths: "Test fixtures are deterministic — fixed CLOCK, zero-padded ids". Important #5 criticizes the assertion (length only), not the fixtures. Shared state is raised only in Minor #9.

criteria.criterion: Every Critical/Important finding cites file:line with a trigger and outcome
criteria.evidence: #1 handlers.js:18 {page:1,size:10}→ord_00000010; #2 handlers.js:37 total:-5→201, nothing stored, process exits; #3 handlers.js:16-18 {page:-1}→200 []; #4 handlers.js:36 omitting createdAt→record persisted with no timestamp; #5 test/handlers.test.js:21-27 offset 10 still gives length 10, so the suite stays green.
